notices.title: Welcome to SHADOWFRAG
notices.summary: News from the dojo, delivered straight to your main menu.
notices.body:
This is a sample announcement for the SHADOWFRAG notice board.

Future notices will bring you development updates, playtest information, and news from the dojo. You can read them here without leaving the game.

notices.title: Find your flow
notices.summary: Chain a leap, a double jump, and a chi jump in the dojo.
notices.body:
Sample training notice.

Visit the dojo to practice movement at your own pace. Try a forward leap, change direction with a double jump, and use a chi jump to cross a gap.

This sample is not a scheduled event or a new patch announcement.

notices.title: Your ninja, your style
notices.summary: Try a different weapon and turn your ninja around in the menu.
notices.body:
Sample cosmetics notice.

Open Cosmetics to explore your ninja's appearance. The main-menu weapon choices let you see how different weapons look in hand; drag the ninja to turn the preview.

This sample does not announce a store, a sale, or a reward.
